# BasicSR 1.4.2

This universal wheel was built from the [BasicSR 1.4.2 source release](https://pypi.org/project/basicsr/1.4.2/) using Python 3.11. Bundling the wheel lets uv install the same package on Python 3.13, where the original source packaging fails to resolve the version from `locals()`. The archive includes the upstream Apache-2.0 license.
